headline: Asteroid missed. Banks back. Bags still lost. Still here.

items.line: Bus-sized asteroid 2026 WA passed at 2:59 a.m. ET, a third of the way to the Moon. It missed. They always miss. So far.
items.title: Asteroid 2026 WA passes at 0.33 lunar distances, about the size of a bus

items.line: The bank outages look over. That's Outlook, the FAA and Chase in under a week.
items.title: Widespread service outages at major U.S. banks appear to be over

items.line: The FAA now says one router in Arkansas set off last week's nationwide ground stop. Experts are still arguing.
items.title: FAA: L3Harris router in Arkansas sparked nationwide ground stop

items.line: Kansas City is still sorting hundreds of bags, Orlando has 100-plus piled up, Seattle and Nashville are backed up. The ground stop was last week.
items.title: KCI still sorting hundreds of bags after nationwide ground stop

items.line: A couple who missed their wedding because of the ground stop got married at the airport instead.
items.title: Couple who missed wedding due to nationwide ground stop married at airport

items.line: Hackers slipped card-stealing code into 178 big websites, BBC, CNN and Zoom included, through one vendor they all use.
items.title: Over 170 Organisations, Including BBC, CNN and Zoom, Hit by Malicious Code in Major Cyberattack
